newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: North says its wants to expand zinc output.
newsitem.headline: North says its wants to expand zinc output.

text.p: Australia's North Ltd said on Wednesday it is seeking to more than double its exposure to the international zinc market through further exploration or acquisition of a second zinc mine.
North currently owns the Zinkgruvan zinc mine in Sweden, producing about 65,000 tonnes of concentrates a year.
"We expect to grow to 90,000 tonnes at that mine over the next three years," Malcolm Broomhead, deputy managing director of North, told Reuters.
Eventually, North would like to see its position in zinc double to closer to 180,000 tonnes of output a year, he said.
